summary: ReFuels N.V. designs, develops, and operates biomethane and compressed natural gas (CNG) refueling stations in the United Kingdom and Europe. It is also involved in the sourcing, aggregation, and supply of renewable biomethane from producers; and dispensing of Bio-CNG into commercial vehicles, as well as generation of renewable transport fuel certificates. ReFuels N.V. was founded in 2014 and is headquartered in Amsterdam, the Netherlands.
